title: Murder in Kfarze: Ilyas' introduction
source_text:
Bә Kfarze kәtwa… ʕoyašwa eba ṭáyeste ŭ mšiḥóyeste. 
Kәtwa ar+rabe dә Kfarze d̥ḥәkmiwa bu+zabnawo, bann+alfo ŭ čaʕmo ŭ čaʕ ŭ ḥamši. 
I+naqlayo ar+rabone dәKfarze, ann+aġawin dәKfarze be Xátewayne. 
Haṯe ʕayla, ʕayla me di+qriṯoyo, maṭ+ṭaye. 
Hawi ʕam zabno dəžmə́nayiye bayn i+ʕaylaṯe ŭ bayn ʕayla da+mšiḥoye. 
Manyo i+ʕaylaṯe? 
I+ʕaylaṯe, kәmmila u+Šamʕәn du+Išḳo. 
U+Šamʕәn du+Išḳo, hánoste, kosōm qačaxčitiye  bayn Túrkiya bayn Súriya. 
Yani, dәmmina, kuzzeyo, kәmbal silā́ḥ, kәmṭe silā́ḥ, ŭ kәmṭe medone du+qačaġ, ŭ kәmbal medone du+qačaġ, u+šuġlano kosōmle.
 Hani be Xáteste kosaymi u+gәllәhayḏe, be Xáteste košuġli ʕam i+dawle, ʕam i+dawle d̥ Túrkiya. 
ŭ mede d̥qudri … ŭ mede dәbʕi kәppe saymi, qawyene ġắlăbe bi+dawle. 
Hə́nnәkste kosaymi u+gәllәh du+Šamʕәn, du+Šamʕәn du+Išḳo, lašan dmazәbṭile dmaḥtile bu+ḥappәs. 
U+Šamʕәn du+Ìšḳoste dínaqqa dəsәmme i+šәkwayḏe, mahzamle. 
Mahzamle lu+Šamʕәn, azzeyo l Súriya. 
Azzé l Súriya, yawmo, tre, tloṯo, yarḥo. 
Bi+ḥarayto omar, ‘Ksolaqno, gdoṯeno, yani, me Súriya lә Kfarze’. 
Ḥa+lalyo aṯi, omar, ‘Ono ŭ be Xate, kobaʕno doṯina lәḥḏoḏe. 
Áydarbo kәbʕina doṯina ləḥḏoḏe?’ 
Omar, ‘Ṭroṯe noše baynoṯayna mamṭelan lәḥḏoḏe, gdowina bәšlomo, yani, dlo+quṭlina ḥḏoḏe, dlo+saymina mede bәḥḏoḏe’. 
Mamṭənne lәḥḏoḏe lan+noše, ŭ mamṭənne lәḥḏoḏe. 
U+Šamʕәn fāš, hiye ŭ hәnnәk, hawən ġắlăbe dōst ʕam ḥḏoḏe, yarḥo, tre, tloṯo, bu+šәklano. 
Kuzzé ŭ oṯe l Súriya ŭ kosolaq lә Kfárzeste. 
Qačaxčitiye kosṓm, šuġle háwoyo. 
Híyeste maḥatle bhawne, omar, ‘Kolozam aš+šaqṣatani sōmno mede appe. 
Mә‿sōmno appe? 
Kobaʕno d̥qoṭálnanne’. 
Koṯe ánnaqqa blalyo, kul lalyo, dәmmina, koṯe me ʕIwárdoyo, aw koṯe me qәryawoṯe ḥréneyo. 
Qačaxčiyo.
 Koṯe lgabayye li+ǧәvate, koṯe lgabayye li+ǧәvate. 
Ínaqqa d̥koʕobar lawġul, koballe u+silāḥ alle, u+silaḥayḏe komaḥatle tamo. 
ŭ kito čalkoyo treste aʕme, ḥawrone áʕmene. 
Hániste kosaymi qačaxčitiye ʕam ḥḏoḏe, kosaymi šuġlo.
 Kelə́n áʕmene, aṯən ltamo. 
Kul lalyo obewa u+silaḥayḏe alle. 
Ḥa mal+lalye omar, ‘U+silāḥayḏi lә+gbene’. 
Aṯi, ʕabər lawġul, štalle i+čayaṯṯe axəlle u+muklaṯṯe. 
Bәṯr mәd nafәq larwal, bәṯr mәd nafәq larwal, hiye mәtfakarle, sәmle u+pilan d̥qoṭalle, u+lalyawo d̥qoṭalle. 
Nafәq larwal, hnele, yani, markawle u+silāḥ d̥qoṭal ḥa mәnne, qoṭal u+babaṯṯe, u+rabo d̥kulle. 
Dínaqqa dәhné lu+babaṯṯe,  zbәṭle u+Šamʕәn, zbәṭle u+Šamʕәn. 
Lu+čalkoyo me bәṯre maḥatle  u+silāḥ aʕle. 
Maḥatle u+silāḥ aʕle, qṭile. 
Aṯi u+àbroste, nafәq. 
U+abro nafәq me larwal ... žәxwá me larġul mu+bayto. 
Dínaqqa dnafәq, maḥatle silāḥ ʕal háwoste, qṭile háwoste. 
Veǧa  ǧġeni máṯeste,  ǧġeni máṯeste, lu+Šamʕәn kə́twayle problám ḥreno, kə́twayle problám ḥreno. 
Kə́twayle ḥurma mšiḥayto, gawírowa, gawírowa. 
I+ḥurmayḏe kәtla ahl b Mәḏyaḏ, harke. 
Kәtla ahl b Mәḏyaḏ, u+ahlano diḏa. 
Kәtte ʕlaymo, hiya  ʕlaymo, hiya ŭ ʕlaymano dəb Mәḏyaḏ kәmmi korәḥmi ḥḏoḏe.
 Hiya gawə́rtoyo. 
I+ḥurma du+Šamʕәnano gawə́rtoyo ʕam u+Šamʕәn. 
Bas hiye, u+Šamʕәn, ʕal d̥kuzzeyo l  Súriya ŭ koṯe, lə+kfōš ġắlăbe bu+bayto. 
Híyaste konәfqo me Kfarze, kuṯyo l Mәḏyaḏ. 
Kәtla ahl b Məḏyaḏ, hiya ŭ ʕlaymawo. 
U+Šamʕәn košomaʕ d̥kәtte ʕalaqat ʕam ḥḏoḏe. 
U+Šamʕәn omar, ‘Madā́m  i+ḥurmaṯe, an+noše komamṭi baḥәs  diḏa, komәǧġoli bәṯra, ono kobaʕno dmarfeno i+ḥurmaṯe. 
Ono gmarfena, lә+gbaʕna’. 
Komarfela. 
Bayn ele ŭ li+ʕaylayo dbe hno, da+mšiḥoye, yani, hiye ŭ u+ḥәmyono, hani kowən dəžmə́n lәḥḏoḏe. 
Marfele i+barṯaṯṯe, hawən dəžmə́n lәḥḏoḏe. 
Hániste kowən, xŭd әmmat, mәrhṓv ʕamani be Xate. 
Kowən ḥa, qarší du+Šamʕәn, qarší du+Šamʕәn, u+Šamʕәn azzeyo, yani, d̥qo... u+lalyawo, dínaqqa dәqṭile aṭ+ṭaye, marfele kmo+silaḥat ʕal u+mšiḥòyoste.  
D̥qoṭele, lo+qadәr d̥qoṭele. 
Yani hawiwa măsale bayn ele ŭ la+mšiḥòyeste ŭ bayn ele ŭ aṭ+ṭàyeste, bu+šәklano. 
ŭ bәṯr, bu+lalyawo bәṯr mәdәqṭile aṭ+ṭayanək, azzeyo, mahzamle, azzeyo l ʕIwardo. 
Fāš u+lalyawo b ʕIwardo, me ʕIwardo azzeyo l Súriya, li+Qamәšlo, mi+Qamәšlo azzeyo l Lubnā́n ŭ me Lubnā́n azzeyo l Awuṣtralya. 
Hūl uʕdo әšqaḏ tәltaḏ ʕoyašwa b Awuṣtralya.

sentences.translation: He shot his weapon at him, he killed him.

sentences.source_line: Aṯi u+àbroste, nafәq.
sentences.translation: His son also came, he came out.

sentences.translation: Now then, apart from this, apart from this, Šamʕәn had another problem, he had another problem.

items.value: He had a Christian wife, he was married, he was married.

sentences.translation: His wife has family in Midyat, here.
